spec.name: sprint45_taker_imbalance_cont_btceth
spec.hypothesis: Extreme 5-min taker-buy imbalance (z-score vs trailing 24h) predicts same-direction BTC/ETH return over the next 30 min beyond T1 costs.
spec.power_argument: Expected validation trades >=300: 2 symbols x cap 6/day x >=25 validation days. Assumed 30m return sd ~45bps, so SE at n=300 is ~2.6bps. Clustering may cut effective n by ~2x, giving an SE of ~3.7bps. Minimum detectable net edge ~8bps at one-sided 97.5%. Gross edge must exceed round-trip cost plus 8bps. Below 300 trades, the run is declared unpowered, not FAIL. The validation window length is an assumption to check against the charter.
